question.prompt: The first three terms of an arithmetic sequence are \(2x - 3,\) \(5x - 11,\) and \(3x + 1\) respectively. The \(n\)th term of the sequence is \(2009.\) What is \(n?\)

solutions.explanation:
Consecutive terms of an arithmetic sequence have equal differences. Applying this to the three given terms determines \(x\):
\[
(5x-11)-(2x-3)=(3x+1)-(5x-11).
\]
Simplifying gives
\[
3x-8=-2x+12,
\qquad 5x=20,
\qquad x=4.
\]
The first three terms are therefore \(5,9,13\), so the first term is \(5\) and the common difference is \(4\).

From the first term to the \(n\)th term there are \(n-1\) increases of \(4\). Hence
\[
5+4(n-1)=2009.
\]
Thus \(n-1=2004/4=501\), giving the positive integer index \(n=502\). The answer is \(502\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Find the common difference
